classification.rationale: Solenoid valves are articles of heading 8481, and Section XVII note 2(e) keeps them and their dedicated parts out of heading 8708 even when used in automotive braking systems. Under Section XVI note 2(b), valve parts go to 8481.90, and as parts of solenoid (not hand-operated or check) valves that are not described as valve bodies or steel forgings they fall in 8481.90.90.85. N361135 shows that a valve stem went to 8481.90.9085 while an electromagnet housing went to 8505.90, so the exact part could change the line.
